_comment: Live call N4 of 2026-09-21, fetched read-only from Langfuse and trimmed to the
fields bench/turns.py reads. Dropped: tool schemas, logfire envelopes, resource attributes,
every spoken-text attribute -- that last is the caller's own conversation and no number here

is what the reader has to reconcile, not a fixture written to make it agree.
